question: By what division is the lowest grade distinguished in the threefold scheme?
premises: lowest grade is distinguished by six-cakra divisions
inference: The lowest grade is set apart by six-cakra divisions within the threefold classification.
uncertainties: whether ṣaṭcakra names six cakras or six-cakra divisions
exact doctrinal referent of the lowest grade is not specified here
plain_english: The lowest is indeed distinguished by six-cakra divisions; thus it is threefold, O Śiva.
